race.description: Essential Asset & Fire Provincial Mdn Plate
race.comment: TICKELOVA (8) gets the nod after a pair of close placings this campaign, most recently third at Scone when beaten a long neck after tracking the lead and being pipped late. The move from country grade into harder company is noted, but she is race-fit, third-up and brings the most reliable recent maiden form. WOOTTON TOUCH IT (14) is the key danger, returning from a five-week freshening after closing strongly for third on debut at Scone despite being at long odds. Makes plenty of appeal. EXTREME COURAGE (1) has been around the mark at Wyong, with a third two runs back and a fair fourth last start after beginning slowly, and Rachel King going on is a positive. No excuses today. HIKARI RISING (5) was runner-up on debut at the Sapphire Coast, has natural early speed and still has upside second-up. Keep safe.
